name: FanBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a sea fan coral (gorgonian). The object reveals the raw geometric skeleton of a fan coral — numerous thin cylindrical branches extend upward from a shared base, bifurcating in a planar fan arrangement to form an open lattice network. Rendered without any texture or material color, the pure white mesh clearly exposes the branching hierarchy and overall fan silhouette, with complex shadows highlighting the open spaces within the branch network.
